company.name: Talkiatry
company.shortDescription: Talkiatry provides virtual mental healthcare services covered by insurance, connecting patients with licensed psychiatrists.
company.description: Talkiatry is a company that offers virtual, in-network psychiatry services. The platform allows for virtual visits, ensuring convenience while maintaining a high standard of psychiatric care. The company connects patients with a team of licensed psychiatrists who can provide evaluation, diagnosis, and personalized treatment plans, including medication management if needed. Talkiatry specializes in treating a range of mental health conditions, such as anxiety, depression, ADHD, and substance use disorders, and aims to make high-quality psychiatric care accessible and convenient for patients.

productsAndServices.description: Online psychiatric evaluation and ongoing care delivered by licensed psychiatrists and psychiatric nurse practitioners through telehealth visits, primarily for patients using accepted insurance plans.
productsAndServices.name: Virtual In-Network Psychiatry

productsAndServices.description: Evaluation, prescribing, monitoring, and adjustment of psychiatric medications when clinically appropriate, with follow-up care to assess effectiveness and side effects.
productsAndServices.name: Psychiatric Medication Management

productsAndServices.description: Therapeutic support integrated into psychiatric visits, including supportive counseling, psychoeducation, and selected evidence-based techniques such as CBT and motivational interviewing.
productsAndServices.name: Supportive Therapy and Psychotherapy

productsAndServices.description: Virtual psychiatric care for children and adolescents ages 5–17, including evaluation, medication management, supportive therapy, and coordination with parents or other care providers.
productsAndServices.name: Child and Adolescent Psychiatry

productsAndServices.description: Specialized psychiatric evaluation and treatment for mental health conditions during pregnancy, after childbirth, or while trying to conceive.
productsAndServices.name: Perinatal and Postpartum Psychiatry

productsAndServices.description: Administrative services that verify insurance eligibility, estimate patient costs, submit claims, and bill patients after insurers determine their covered responsibility.
productsAndServices.name: Insurance Eligibility, Copay Estimation, and Billing
